findings.highlight: she said a shiniku is a lump of meat
findings.evidenceJa: 中国に伝わる幾ら食べても減らない肉、だったっけか
findings.governingReading: だったっけか marks his private recollection; Rin only compares the practice material to shiniku.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s uncertain remembered gloss of shiniku becomes an explanation Rin gave him.

findings.highlight: your way of thinking is incorrect.
findings.evidenceJa: 貴方の場合は教え方が間違えられていた
findings.governingReading: 教え方が間違えられていた assigns the problem to faulty instruction, after questions about his teacher.
findings.explanation: Being taught incorrectly becomes Shirou’s way of thinking being incorrect.

findings.evidenceJa: ちょっと薬を飲んでもらうだけだから
findings.governingReading: 薬を飲む identifies medicine as the nonsurgical intervention.

findings.highlight: You won't be able to move for a while because of how strong it is.
findings.evidenceJa: しばらくは動けなくなるけどね」
findings.governingReading: The completed explanation is enclosed as speech in Japanese.
findings.explanation: Rin’s treatment explanation lacks a closing quotation mark.

findings.governingReading: 五時前 places the time before the hour.
findings.explanation: Before five o’clock becomes past five.
